p: בַּזֹּהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (אֱמוֹר, זֹהַר חֵלֶק ג קג, ב):
In the holy Zohar (Emor, Zohar III 103b):
"You shall dwell in sukkos seven days" (Vayikra 23:42):
be seated, guests of faith, be seated."
are a chariot for the seven middos
וְאִיתָא (רַעְיָא מְהֵימְנָא פִּנְחָס, זֹהַר חֵלֶק ג רנה, ב):
And it is stated (Ra'aya Mehemna, Pinchas, Zohar III 255b):
is in the secret of the two combinations,
And so sukkah comes to that in numerical value, etc.
That is, sukkah written full is Malchus,
and it has the vav within it,
for the middah of Malchus surrounds the vav;
and this is in the secret of
as it will be in the future,
when Hakadosh Baruch Hu will make
a circle of dancers for the tzaddikim,
and He will sit among them in Gan Eden
And sukkah written lacking is Binah,
for the s'chach covers over the vav,
and it is as a surrounding light above.
dwells in the midst of Bnei Yisrael,
and there is formed the supernal sukkah, Binah,
which is the middah of Malchus within Binah,
And this is the matter of a sukkah
for it is Malchus, the tenth,
That is, when the sukkah includes all ten,
in the manner of what is said
it is stated in Ra'aya Mehemna:
for it is kaf, Keser Elyon, etc.,
and Kudsha Brich Hu answered him,
and there is no kavod without kaf, etc."
That is, sukkah is Binah, teshuvah;
and the fiftieth gate is the da'as
that was revealed to Rabbi Akiva and his colleagues
and was not revealed to Moshe Rabbeinu
knew nothing of evil at all:
when he was born the house filled with light,
"Every precious thing his eye has seen" (Iyov 28:10)
this is Rabbi Akiva and his colleagues
(as written in Midrash Rabbah and Tanchuma, Chukas,
בַּמִּדְבָּר רַבָּה יט, ו; תַּנְחוּמָא חֻקַּת ח);
things that were not revealed to Moshe
were revealed to Rabbi Akiva and his colleagues.
And this is what was said (Berachos 34b):
"In the place where baalei teshuvah stand,
completely righteous people do not stand."
That is because they draw with greater force;
and another tip, which shines to Binah
וַיִּקְרָא, זֹהַר חֵלֶק ג י, ב).
וְזֶה שֶׁאָמַר וְלֵית כָּבוֹד בְּלָא כ׳:
And this is what it says, "there is no kavod without kaf":
and a sukkah of twenty is valid,
only above twenty is it invalid.
And there is one who merits, even in our times,
that is, one who merits the 'supernal Shabbos,'
from this he merits the 'exalted guests,'
שֶׁהַסּוּכָּה סוֹכֵךְ גַּם עַל גַּבֵּי ו׳
for the sukkah covers also over the vav,
וְכָל אֶחָד מִיִּשְׂרָאֵל עַל כָּל פָּנִים
And every single Jew, at the very least,
which is the middah of Malchus;
and this one merits the 'guests of faith.'
And this is what it says:
"He would raise his hands and rejoice:
as it is written, 'For Hashem's portion is His people'"
שֶׁעַל כָּל פָּנִים כָּל אֶחָד מִיִּשְׂרָאֵל
for at the very least every single Jew
sukkah is also written lacking the vav;
everyone to merit the supernal sukkah,
a surrounding light over the vav,
like Yaakov, who merited the middah of emes,
as it is written, "The lip of truth shall be established forever"
to dwell in the shade of faith;
(רַעְיָא מְהֵימְנָא פִּנְחָס, זֹהַר חֵלֶק ג רל, א):
"He is emes and She is emunah";
one merits the guests of faith.
